Component library as-built (Phase 2 as-built) ​

2026-10-16. Where the redesign-plan §5 component library actually landed in the repo. The design draft is external input; this document records the in-repo facts that have already landed: the single token source, the component factory inventory, the consolidated surface, and the not-yet-consolidated remainder. For the vocabulary and the contract see redesign-2026-10-16-契约.md (widget side).

1 Token system (single source and delegation) ​

DimensionSingle sourcePlacement
Font size / corner radius / spacingsrc/Beacon.App/Services/DesignTokens.cs8 font sizes + 6 corner radii + spacing scale; the only source on the App-side C# surface
Corner radius (XAML surface)src/Beacon.App/App.xaml resource mirrorWinUI 3 has no x:Static, so XAML can only use StaticResource; the C# and XAML copies must be changed in sync (both sides carry sync-warning comments)
Color / severity colorsUiPalette (App) + PaletteResolver/HighContrastPalette (Core)Component factories never hold color; brushes are resolved by the caller and passed in
Base foreground/backgroundThemeColors (App.Windows)Progress-bar track base color and the like are derived via Opacity
MotionMotionEngine (App)Single source for durations/easing; components do not embed animation constants
Size / DPIDpiLayoutMath (Core)DIP→px conversion happens exactly once at the Win32 boundary (same convention in all four windows)
Progress tiersProgressTiers (Core, 0.8/0.98 thresholds)PinnedHost BarFillColor delegates to it; the App no longer holds the thresholds

Value-equivalence discipline: consolidation is always zero value change (anchored by the CI S/O/Q/F5/G pixel assertions); off-scale literals like 3 (detail-table row spacing, chip top/bottom spacing) are brought into components at their original values with comments — visuals are never changed as a side effect of consolidation.

2 Component factory inventory (src/Beacon.App/Components/) ​

Conventions: internal static class factories; components hold typography/geometry (via DesignTokens) and never hold color (brushes come from the caller); conditional children are always added imperatively via Add (a null inside a collection initializer blows up at runtime).

FactoryPiecesAdopted by (in-repo facts)
ComponentTextCaption / BodyQuickPanel status rows/event rows (a517594)
ComponentIconStatusDotQuickPanel row-leading light
ComponentSurfaceCardVocabulary piece (settings card face follows the same convention)
ComponentBadgeCountVocabulary piece
ComponentDividerHorizontalVocabulary piece
ComponentStatusIndicator / OfflineHollowDetailWindow header light (bf95dde); the hollow variant = the capsule offline-banner convention
ComponentMetricValueVocabulary piece (waiting on Phase 3 binding)
ComponentProgressFillColor / BarFillColor delegates to ProgressTiers; Bar is a static-bar vocabulary piece
ComponentKeyValueRowDetailWindow detail table (1db70de)
ComponentListVerticalDetailWindow detail table container
ComponentCardStatusVocabulary piece (a Surface.Card composition)
ComponentActionButton / Item / Menu / LinkDetail action area + QuickPanel pin context menu (bb86927); Link is a vocabulary piece
ComponentLayoutRow / Column / Columns / SectionLabel / WhenQuickPanel's three rows and empty-section collapse, Detail header row/action row/section labels, PinnedHost six columns (8caf0b5)
ComponentFeedbackEmpty / Loading / Error / OfflineVocabulary piece (5489352); the current UX convention = empty-section hiding + XAML banners

3 Not-yet-consolidated remainder (advanced surface by surface; does not block the phase) ​

  • Bespoke Thickness: chip Padding(8,3,8,3), capsule/panel XAML padding — handled along the way when the corresponding surfaces get componentized.
  • The SettingsWindow button family (about 17 new Button sites): form buttons, not 「动作」 (action) vocabulary; waiting for the form-componentization batch.
  • XAML-surface layout (QuickPanelWindow.xaml's Grid/Stack): XAML has no factory to land in; the resource-mirror constraint stays.

4 Proof surface ​

The proof for adopted pieces = CI pixel assertions (green as long as value equivalence holds). The proof surface for the vocabulary pieces (Surface/Badge/Divider/Metric/StatusCard/ Link/Column/Feedback four states) = the independent visual example page at the end of Phase 2 (todo phasing row 9) and the Phase 3 binding engine; landing with no adopting surface is the by-design vocabulary stage, not a finished state.
